value.rationale: This is a structural permanence theorem for the central tiling property characterized by the focal paper. Directly intersecting tiles with a subspace need not transparently preserve the tiling/body conditions, whereas the renorming characterization makes heredity exact. The statement also covers nonclosed and incomplete subspaces, a scope unavailable from the classical separable Banach characterization. It is a concise but mathematically reusable closure property rather than a parameter tweak or recomputation.
